description: This file defines a base class for Whisper-based speech-to-text (STT) services, providing common functionality such as language mapping, metrics handling, and transcription processing. It includes methods for configuring the service, managing languages, and handling transcription results, intended for extension by specific implementation classes.

classes.name: BaseWhisperSTTService
classes.description: A base class for implementing Whisper-based speech-to-text services, providing common configurations, language handling, metrics, and a framework for transcription processing.

methods.name: Optional[str] language_to_whisper_language(language: Language)
methods.description: Maps a pipecat Language enum to the corresponding Whisper API language code.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, base_url: Optional[str] = None, language: Optional[Language] = Language.EN, prompt: Optional[str] = None, temperature: Optional[float] = None, include_prob_metrics: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the base Whisper STT service with configuration parameters like model, API key, language, etc.

methods.name: set_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Sets the model name for transcription.

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Indicates that the service supports metric generation.

methods.name: Optional[str] language_to_service_language(self, language: Language)
methods.description: Converts a pipecat Language enum to a service-specific language code.

methods.name: _handle_transcription( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[Language] = None )
methods.description: Handles transcription results, potentially including tracing, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_stt(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Performs speech-to-text by transcribing audio data and yielding transcription or error frames.

methods.name: Transcription _transcribe(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Abstract method to transcribe raw audio data; must be implemented in subclasses.

ctags.signature: ( self, *, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, base_url: Optional[str] = None, language: Optional[Language] = Language.EN, prompt: Optional[str] = None, temperature: Optional[float] = None, include_prob_metrics: bool = False, **kwargs, )

ctags.signature: ( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[Language] = None )
